summary: FreshBoard.lol iteration 2 testing (backend + frontend mobile). Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed covering all regression endpoints (/config, /reset-info, /board+category, /submit valid+validations, /outbid, /payments/status, /webhook/stripe bad-sig, /activity, /stats, /top-today) plus new features (/preview valid+invalid, /yesterday-top seed+null, WebSocket /api/ws/board hello frame, reconnect, and broadcast wiring verified via code inspection since server runs in a separate process from tests). Frontend mobile @ 375px: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==innerWidth==375), category chips wrap onto 4 rows (13 chips), submission modal width=351 within viewport (max-h works), WebSocket to /api/ws/board connects successfully. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: WebSocket broadcast test at test file uses code-inspection fallback because pytest cannot invoke _apply_paid_transaction in the running server process. Real end-to-end WS broadcast would require completing a Stripe checkout (not possible in automated test) or an internal admin endpoint to simulate paid transactions. Wiring is correct — ws_manager.broadcast is invoked at end of _apply_paid_transaction with type='board_update'.
Consider adding /api/webhook/stripe simulation endpoint gated by env var for e2e testing of the broadcast path.
server.py is ~700 lines and mixes models, routes, WS manager, and Stripe helpers. Splitting into modules (models.py, ws.py, payments.py, routes/*) would improve maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Seeded one TEST_FB_Yesterday listing (removed in same test); TEST_FB_Prod submit_valid creates a pending Stripe txn (harmless, remains as pending).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers 23 tests. To reproduce true WS broadcast, would need either (a) an admin/dev endpoint to force _apply_paid_transaction, or (b) direct import within the running server process. WS hello and connect/disconnect are verified live.
